biography:
Meet the Artist

Aishwarya Dake
Artist & Founder

I believe the right artwork can completely change how a space feels.
At Colors N Joy, I personally conceptualize and oversee every project—from the first design idea to the final installation.
My focus is not simply to create beautiful artwork, but to create pieces that feel designed for the space they belong to—considering its architecture, proportions, light, textures and overall character.
Every Colors N Joy artwork is thoughtfully designed and handcrafted, with an emphasis on detail, materiality and individuality.


The Studio

Where Creativity Meets Craftsmanship
Colors N Joy is a custom wall art studio specializing in:

- Statement Wall Art
- Texture & Relief Art
- Canvas Artworks
- Designer Art Clocks

Each piece is custom-designed to become a natural part of your space—not just wall décor.
